summary: POMDOCTOR Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share, following a prior deficiency notice. The Company received confirmation that its ADS closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. This is a routine compliance update with no transaction, strategic change, or corporate action. The matter is closed and its shares continue trading on Nasdaq under "POM." No special-situation event is present; this is an ordinary listing status report.
